source.note: Bank's own early-career and internships page. The class-year sentence is cited to the research-associate-program page, which is where the Bank states it.

apply.note: Bank's own early-career page; positions are posted in the Bank's career portal.

class_year.quote: The Bank’s summer internship program is open to students who have completed their sophomore year of college by the start of the internship.

compensation.quote: The Federal Reserve Bank of Boston provides paid internships, research associate roles, and entry-level jobs for students, early professionals, and those re-entering the workforce.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl' and 'apply again': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: Each summer (May-August), the Bank welcomes undergraduate and graduate students to work across a range of departments and business areas.
The Research Department summer internship program is open to undergraduate and graduate students majoring in economics, finance, statistics or mathematics.

provenance.origin: Bank's own early-career and research-associate pages
provenance.note: The sophomore-year rule is the sharpest class-year statement of the six Reserve Banks recorded in this pass, and it sits on the research-associate-program page rather than the internships landing page, so it is cited there. Sponsorship is silent: the page contains no occurrence of citizen, visa, CPT, OPT, sponsor or work authorisation. That silence is worth noting rather than assuming, because the Federal Reserve Board states a flat citizenship bar and the Atlanta Fed states a CPT position, while this body publishes neither. Silent here means only that nothing is published on the point.
